title: Photo lightbox
description: An austere photographic index opens a dark, contained viewer with thumbnails, bounded zoom and pan.
useCase: Inspect a photograph closely without losing its collection context.
interaction: Open a photograph; browse, enlarge and drag. Arrow keys browse or pan the enlarged image.
reducedMotion: The viewer opens immediately and fit-to-image changes skip interpolation.
limitations: The viewer is scoped to its component bounds, not a page-level modal. Photographs have separate Unsplash terms.
look: Off-white page with a row of four tall, staggered-height photographs (architecture, surf, running track, tennis courts), each with a small caption and arrow.
motion: Selecting a photo opens a dark viewer instantly; enlarging jumps the image to 1.7× for drag or arrow-key panning within clamped bounds, and fitting eases it back over 240 ms.
adapt: Zoom and pan are one inline `transform` on the viewer image (`scale(${zoom ? 1.7 : 1})` plus `pan`), bounded by `clampPan`; fitting eases via the `.pl-view img` transition `.24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`. Replace `PHOTOS`; the dialog is scoped to the component, not the page.
